title: Web Security Fundamentals
tagline: Master the OWASP Top 10 and defend the modern web
description: Learn to think like an attacker and defend like a professional. This course covers the most critical web vulnerabilities — SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, broken authentication, and more — through hands-on labs, real breach case studies, and guided challenges. By the end, you'll be able to identify, exploit, and remediate the vulnerabilities that cause 90% of all web application breaches.
learningObjectives: Understand how SQL injection, XSS, and CSRF attacks work at a technical level
Execute attacks safely in isolated lab environments
Identify vulnerabilities in code before attackers do
Implement parameterized queries, output encoding, and CSRF tokens
Read and interpret the OWASP Top 10 report
Write a basic penetration test report for a web application
author: Cyber Learn Team
